policy.completeness_rule: Explicit authoritative period coverage required for negative action findings. Failed access, snippets and individual dividend announcements cannot establish completeness. Conflicts remain unresolved.
policy.gap_policy: At invalid price boundary return unavailable INVALID_BOUNDARY, never zero. Unknown boundary dates block certification.
policy.identity_rule: Dated NSE security/symbol/series evidence with reviewed period coverage required. Current broker mapping alone never suffices.
policy.scope: Frozen universe and window only. No strategy outcomes, no candles, no universe redesign. Access dates outside semantic evidence fingerprint. New evidence requires a new generation.

segmentation_policy.other_actions: Reviewed actual listed-security mechanics determine boundary; rights/buyback/subsidiary events are not automatic splits. Unknown mechanics remain unresolved.
segmentation_policy.segments: Half-open segments at confirmed effective trading boundary; no splice or local adjustment.
